strings: Some of the water m_c inhaled appears to be draining from {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} nose as well as coming up in those hacking coughs. r_c puts {PRONOUN/m_c/object} on nest rest to help {PRONOUN/m_c/object} recover.
Along with a bit of coughing, m_c has developed a runny nose from the water in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} lungs.
